## 🤖 Agent Task

<!--
Use this template for work that will be delegated to an AI coding agent (AI involvement Level 4).
Agents only act on tasks that a maintainer has created or approved. A clear scope and verifiable
acceptance criteria lead to better results. See AI_POLICY.md and AGENTS.md.
-->

### 📜 Description

<!-- [REQUIRED] Describe the task and why it is needed, in one or two short paragraphs. -->

### 🎯 Acceptance Criteria

<!-- [REQUIRED] List verifiable conditions that must be true when the task is done. -->

<!-- example:
- [ ] The README lists the new file in the file structure and the description list
- [ ] All Markdown files pass the lint check described in AGENTS.md
-->

### 📚 Context

<!-- [REQUIRED] Give the agent the background it needs: relevant files, related issues or PRs, decisions already made, and examples to follow. -->

### 📂 Scope

<!-- [REQUIRED] Define what the agent may and may not change. -->

<!-- example:
- In scope: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md
- Out of scope: LICENSE, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, .github/workflows/
-->

### 🧪 Validation

<!-- [REQUIRED] List the commands or checks the agent must run, and how it should report the results. -->

<!-- example:
- Run the checks in the "Commands" section of AGENTS.md
- List any check that could not be run, and why
-->

### 🚧 Constraints

<!-- [OPTIONAL] Rules about style, compatibility, dependencies, performance, or security. Remove if not needed. -->

### 👤 Human Sponsor

<!-- [REQUIRED] @username of the person who is accountable for this task and will review the agent's pull request. -->

### 🔗 Related Issues or PRs

<!-- [OPTIONAL] Link to any related issues or pull requests. Remove if not needed. -->

### 📝 Additional Information

<!-- [OPTIONAL] Any additional context for the agent or the reviewers. Remove if not needed. -->
